text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service *inference-prod* (High CPU - model-serving). Sent to schedules: `sre-oncall-primary`, `contractors-night-shadow`. Incident ID: PDI216543. 3 initial pages.

maria: Anyone oncall? I got a DM that contractors are getting pages.

kevin: got the page but I'm listed as `backup_contractors` — I shouldn't be in prod routing. acked by mistake while checking, sorry.

anya: I am SRE oncall for the shift and I didn't get a page. I just noticed multiple duplicates in PD timeline.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation triggered (5m) — routed to escalation policy `eng-escalation-1` -> recipients: `engineering-all`.

linda: Customers reporting inference latency ~300-400ms higher around 12:02-12:06. Not widespread but a couple of tenants saw spikes. Paging looks like it's fanout to a stale shadow schedule bound in service metadata.

sre-oncall: Looking at metrics — small cpu blip on a single node, likely noise. Alert threshold combined with new metric tag caused misfire. PD shows an extra binding to `contractors-night-shadow` added 2025-11-02 by infra-sync.

kevin: output from PD CLI:
``
$ pd service show inference-prod
Bindings:
 - schedule: sre-oncall-primary
 - schedule: contractors-night-shadow (stale)
Escalation policy: eng-escalation-1
```

maria: I'm going to pause escalation for the service to stop further fanout. Doing `pd escalation-policy disable-eng-escalation-1 --temp 30m` (manual via console).

anya: Also please remove the shadow schedule binding from the service. I'll claim the incident and coordinate handoff.

linda: On it, I've removed the `contractors-night-shadow` binding in PD UI and temporarily silenced `inference-prod` for 15m. Confirming pages stop.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: silence applied to service `inference-prod` for 15m.

kevin: Confirmed no more pages after silence. good call.

maria: Customer impact summary: 2 customers observed increased latency for ~4 minutes, no errors or request failures. No data exfiltration. Recommend severity: P2 -> keep oncall.

anya: I'll open the incident ticket and write the timeline + RCA owner. Initial notes: cause = stale PD binding + recent metric tag change; mitigation = remove binding + silence + change alert threshold.

maria: Follow-ups: (1) audit PD bindings across prod services (owner: platform-sre), (2) add CI check to alert-sync to reject schedule bindings not in allowed list, (3) review on-call roster automation that added the shadow schedule. Owners: eng-oncall, infra-sync.

kevin: suggest we also add a check in deploy pipeline that runs `pd service validate` before shipping infra-sync changes.

pagerduty-bot: Note: last ack by kevin (wrong responder) — please review access and make sure contractors are not in production service bindings. :eyes:

linda: I'll create the follow-up ticket and include related PD incident and logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2165

anya: Assigning postmortem to me. Will schedule a 30m triage call tomorrow and invite platform-sre and infra-sync. Thanks all.

maria: Good job team, especially quick identification of the stale binding. Closing thread when postmortem doc exists. :thumbsup:
